none: PAS CPAT-1C8D76: Roman to Medieval Spindle Whorl Possibly Anglo Saxon
contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

This lead spindle whorl is bi-conical in form and decorated on both sides and is possibly, Anglo Saxon in origin. In size, it is smaller and thus, lighter than the ‘typical’ spindle whorl. The decoration resembles runic, or pseudo runic script. Whilst it is always difficult to tie down a particular date for lead spindle whorls as they span from Roman to the post medieval, this form of decoration…
